articles.title: NASA's Space Fridge Makes the Coldest, Weirdest Matter in the Universe!
articles.summary: Imagine a fridge in space that gets colder than anywhere in the universe—colder than outer space itself! Inside, atoms slow down so much they turn into a wavy, ghost-like fifth state of matter. This helps scientists build super-precise tools for the future.

articles.title: Did Aliens Send a Space Rock? Scientists Checked—Here's What They Found!
articles.summary: A mysterious object from another star system zoomed through our solar system. Scientists pointed giant radio ears at it, listening for alien signals. After scanning millions of frequencies, they found only Earth-made noise—but the search taught them how to be ready for next time!

articles.title: This Battery Runs on Salt—and It Just Matched Tesla's Power!
articles.summary: A Chinese company made a battery using cheap, common sodium instead of expensive lithium. Scientists tested it and were shocked: it's just as powerful and well-made as Tesla's batteries! It could make electric cars and giant power banks way cheaper.
